$comment: Production npm advisories the Security gate tolerates. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails CI so it gets re-reviewed. Only add advisories with no patched release that are verified absent from the deployed SSR function (.netlify/v1/functions). Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs.
